title: MicroStation workflows and connector status
description: Explore MicroStation workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

MicroStation

MicroStation provides precise 2D and 3D infrastructure design with referenced project information.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Coordinate referenced models

Begin with the selected building, infrastructure or plant elements and their current parameters. In the intended MicroStation preview, coordinate referenced models; the visible result is an updated model view that identifies each affected element. Review levels, connectivity, classification and design intent before accepting or exporting it.

Edit civil geometry

Use the coordinated discipline context and current issue set. In the intended MicroStation preview, edit civil geometry; the visible result is a comparison, check or automation result linked to model objects. Review element identity, clashes, rules and downstream effects before accepting or exporting it.

Publish controlled drawings

Start from the accepted model proposal and document set. In the intended MicroStation preview, publish controlled drawings; the visible result is updated schedules, drawings or issue information derived from the same subject. Review coordination status, quantities and publication scope before accepting or exporting it.
